responses.text: SQL لغة التعامل مع قواعد البيانات. إليك أمثلة:
مثال طويل: استعلامات متقدمة مع JOIN و GROUP BY:
responses.code:
-- إنشاء جداول
CREATE TABLE departments (
    id INT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,
    name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE employees (
    id INT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,
    name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    salary DECIMAL(10,2),
    department_id INT,
    hire_date DATE,
    FOREIGN KEY (department_id) REFERENCES departments(id)
);

-- إدخال بيانات
INSERT INTO departments (name) VALUES ('تقنية'), ('مبيعات'), ('موارد بشرية');
INSERT INTO employees (name, salary, department_id, hire_date) VALUES
('أحمد', 5000, 1, '2020-01-15'),
('سارة', 6000, 1, '2019-03-10'),
('محمد', 4500, 2, '2021-07-01'),
('ليلى', 5500, 3, '2018-11-20');

-- استعلام JOIN
SELECT e.name AS employee, d.name AS department, e.salary
FROM employees e
JOIN departments d ON e.department_id = d.id
ORDER BY e.salary DESC;

-- GROUP BY
SELECT d.name AS department, COUNT(e.id) AS num_employees, AVG(e.salary) AS avg_salary
FROM departments d
LEFT JOIN employees e ON d.id = e.department_id
GROUP BY d.id, d.name;

-- إجراء مخزن
DELIMITER //
CREATE PROCEDURE GetEmployeesByDepartment(IN dept_name VARCHAR(100))
BEGIN
    SELECT e.* FROM employees e
    JOIN departments d ON e.department_id = d.id
    WHERE d.name = dept_name;
END //
DELIMITER ;

CALL GetEmployeesByDepartment('تقنية');

responses.text: مثال طويل: نظام إدارة مكتبة باستخدام classes:
responses.code:
class Book
  attr_accessor :title, :author, :available

  def initialize(title, author)
    @title = title
    @author = author
    @available = true
  end

  def to_s
    "#{@title} - #{@author} [#{@available ? 'متاح' : 'معار'}]"
  end
end

class Library
  def initialize
    @books = []
  end

  def add_book(book)
    @books << book
    puts "تمت إضافة الكتاب: #{book.title}"
  end

  def list_books
    if @books.empty?
      puts "لا توجد كتب."
    else
      @books.each_with_index do |book, index|
        puts "#{index + 1}. #{book}"
      end
    end
  end

  def borrow_book(index)
    if index >= 0 && index < @books.length
      book = @books[index]
      if book.available
        book.available = false
        puts "تم استعارة: #{book.title}"
      else
        puts "الكتاب غير متاح حالياً."
      end
    else
      puts "رقم غير صحيح."
    end
  end
end

library = Library.new
library.add_book(Book.new("مقدمة في البرمجة", "أحمد"))
library.add_book(Book.new("قواعد البيانات", "سارة"))

loop do
  puts "\n1. عرض الكتب\n2. استعارة كتاب\n3. خروج"
  print "اختر: "
  choice = gets.chomp
  case choice
  when "1"
    library.list_books
  when "2"
    library.list_books
    print "رقم الكتاب: "
    index = gets.chomp.to_i - 1
    library.borrow_book(index)
  when "3"
    break
  else
    puts "اختيار خاطئ."
  end
end
